bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs (local notifications only; no device token or push service)
summary: PushKit delivers wake-up pushes for watchOS complications, file providers and VoIP calls through Apple Push Notification service. BifrOSt has local notifications only and no APNs-style push delivery, so the framework has no counterpart on the PC desktop.

features.note: The token is issued by Apple Push Notification service; BifrOSt has no such service

features.apple: PKPushType, Responding to VoIP Notifications from PushKit
features.note: Needs APNs VoIP delivery; calls are not routed through push on the PC

features.apple: Exporting delivery metrics logs, Exporting broadcast push notification metrics

features.note: Metadata for APNs VoIP pushes only
